399	  wishlist: {
400	    showBag: true,
401	    showAttributes: true,
402	    showSizeChips: true,
403	    hoverHidesPrice: true,
404	    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
405	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: true,
406	    showRemove: true,
407	    hideBagOnMobile: false,
408	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: true,
409	    showBadge: true,
410	    showHoverImageSwap: true,
411	    showContent: true,
412	  },
413	  recentlyViewed: {
414	    showBag: false,
415	    showAttributes: false,
416	    showSizeChips: false,
417	    hoverHidesPrice: false,
418	    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
419	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: false,
420	    showRemove: false,
421	    // Moot — there is no bag on any viewport for this variation (Card-content is hidden
422	    // wholesale below), so this flag never actually applies. Figma nodes: Desktop 40000307:12444,
423	    // Tablet 40000730:13363, Mobile 40000538:25030 — Card-content `hidden="true"` on all three.
424	    hideBagOnMobile: false,
425	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
426	    showBadge: false,
427	    showHoverImageSwap: false,
428	    showContent: false,
429	  },
430	};
431	
432	const messages = defineMessages({
433	  // Interpolated with the product name, matching ZimmProductPrice's WAS/NOW pattern — Media's
434	  // own `removeLabel` prop is a plain string, so the interpolation happens here, at the one call
435	  // site that actually knows the product name.
436	  removeFromWishlist: {
437	    id: 'product_card.remove.from_wishlist',
438	    defaultMessage: 'Remove {name} from wishlist',
439	  },
440	});
441	
442	const ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_RECIPE = 'ZimmProductCard';
443	
444	/**
445	 * Organism — the full product card, composing `ZimmProductCardMedia` and `ZimmProductCardContent`
446	 * across the `home` / `plp` / `wishlist` variations. See the module docblock above for the
447	 * confirmed Figma variation matrix and this component's own recipe (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`) for
448	 * the stretched-link and hover-reveal mechanics that live entirely in CSS, not in this render
449	 * body — both children are always rendered in full, with every one of their own sub-parts; CSS
450	 * alone decides what is visible for a given variation and pointer capability.
451	 *
452	 * @param props see `ZimmProductCardProps` — a discriminated union on `variation`.
453	 */
454	export const ZimmProductCard = (props: ZimmProductCardProps) => {
455	  const {
456	    id,
457	    href,
458	    name,
459	    headingLevel,
460	    primaryImage,
461	    hoverImage,
462	    images,
463	    currentPrice,
464	    originalPrice,
465	    isPriceLoading,
466	    isUnavailable,
467	    onNotifyMe,
468	    badge,
469	    variation,
470	  } = props;
471	
472	  const { onAddToBag, sizeChipValues, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect, colour, size, onRemove } =
473	    props as ZimmProductCardVariationFields;
474	
475	  const intl = useIntl();
476	  const history = useHistory();
477	  const config = VARIATION_CONFIG[variation];
478	
479	  // Both conditions required — an organism that sets isUnavailable without a real callback
480	  // should not show a dead notify-me button. Mirrors ZimmProductCardContent's own
481	  // showNotifyMeButton co-requirement.
482	  const showNotifyMe = Boolean(isUnavailable) && Boolean(onNotifyMe);
483	
484	  // Fix C (SFCC-236 Step 6 visual audit): confirmed against the real Figma Default+Hover
485	  // instances for every variation × Unavailable=True (including the Mobile/no-hover variants,
486	  // which show the only state a touch pointer ever sees) that `isUnavailable` suppresses the
487	  // size-selector hover-swap entirely — there is nothing to pick for an out-of-stock item, so
488	  // price stays visible on hover instead of being replaced. Home's own hover-reveals-price
489	  // behaviour is untouched by this — Home's Unavailable Hover reference (node 40002163:39990)
490	  // still reveals price on hover exactly as the in-stock case does; only the PLP/Wishlist
491	  // hide-and-swap needs suppressing.
492	  //
493	  // Suppressing `hoverRevealsSizeSelector` alone is not enough to reproduce that reference: it
494	  // only stops the organism adding its OWN hide/reveal pair, which leaves the size-chip wrapper
495	  // at Content's own natural (visible) default — briefly shipped that way mid-fix and caught by
496	  // re-checking the real Storybook render against Figma, which confirms size chips stay hidden
497	  // in BOTH states when unavailable, not just "not swapped in on hover". `sizeSelectorUnavailable`
498	  // carries that permanent hide separately, unconditional (not gated by hover-capability at all —
499	  // this isn't a pointer-type concern, unlike everything else in this recipe).
500	  //
501	  // Follow-up (full-sweep visual audit against every variant x state node, not just the sampled
502	  // set the first pass checked): `sizeSelectorUnavailable` ALSO drives a mobile-only price hide
503	  // in the recipe now (Fix F) — confirmed via `get_metadata` that Mobile PLP/Wishlist Unavailable
504	  // hide price and show notify-me in its place (`40002163:41488`, `40002187:58475`), the OPPOSITE
505	  // of Desktop's additive treatment (price stays, notify-me is simply added on hover). Nothing
506	  // extra is computed here for it — the recipe reads the same `sizeSelectorUnavailable` boolean
507	  // for both the size-chip permanent-hide and this new price rule, since both only ever apply to
508	  // the same PLP/Wishlist-and-unavailable case.
509	  const hoverHidesPrice = config.hoverHidesPrice && !isUnavailable;
510	  const hoverRevealsSizeSelector = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && !isUnavailable;
511	  const sizeSelectorUnavailable = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && Boolean(isUnavailable);
512	
513	  // Fix G (same follow-up audit): Wishlist-only. `hideBagOnMobile` alone only covers PLP's own
514	  // unconditional mobile hide; Wishlist's bag stays visible on mobile UNLESS unavailable
515	  // (`40002187:58470` vs `40002187:58473`). Combined into one boolean here rather than exposing
516	  // both conditions to the recipe — it only needs to know "hide this on mobile for this render",
517	  // not why.
518	  const bagHiddenOnMobile = config.hideBagOnMobile || (config.hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable && Boolean(isUnavailable));
519	
520	  const removeLabel = config.showRemove ? intl.formatMessage(messages.removeFromWishlist, { name }) : undefined;
521	  const resolvedBadge = config.showBadge ? badge : undefined;
522	
523	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_RECIPE, {
524	    hoverHidesPrice,
525	    hoverRevealsPrice: config.hoverRevealsPrice,
526	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector,
527	    sizeSelectorUnavailable,
528	    // Same Fix C audit: notify-me is hover-gated on hover-capable devices (hidden by default,
529	    // revealed on hover/focus-visible — every Desktop Unavailable+Hover reference shows it
530	    // appearing only there) but unconditionally visible on touch (every Mobile Unavailable
531	    // reference — the only state a touch pointer ever sees, per the "Mobile has no Hover variant"
532	    // finding — shows it plainly, with no hover to reveal it). This flag is deliberately keyed off
533	    // `showNotifyMe` itself, not `variation`: the confirmed behaviour is identical across all
534	    // three variations, and the recipe's selector simply matches nothing when notify-me isn't
535	    // mounted at all.
536	    hoverRevealsNotifyMe: showNotifyMe,
537	    hideBagOnMobile: bagHiddenOnMobile,
538	  });
539	
540	  // Fix I — see the module docblock's own "Fix I" paragraph for the full narrative. Guards the
541	  // two arrow buttons and the remove/close button (all real <button> descendants of
542	  // ZimmProductCardMedia) so paging/onRemove keep firing on their own and never also navigate.
543	  // Fix L (CodeRabbit finding on PR #85, verified correct before fixing): a real <a> lets the
544	  // browser handle Cmd/Ctrl-click (new tab), Shift-click (new window), and non-primary-button
545	  // clicks natively — this handler only ever replaces the in-page navigation an UNMODIFIED,
546	  // primary-button click used to reach via the stretched-link overlay (see Fix I). Bailing out on
547	  // any of those instead of forcing an in-tab `history.push` regardless of what the shopper
548	  // actually asked for; a no-op here is a real gap (it doesn't open a new tab the way a real link
549	  // would) but is strictly better than silently overriding an explicit "open elsewhere" signal.
550	  const handleMediaClick = (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void => {
551	    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
552	    if (target.closest('button')) return;
553	    if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey || event.button !== 0) return;
554	    history.push(href);
555	  };
556	
557	  return (
558	    <chakra.div __css={styles.root} data-testid="product-card" data-product-id={id}>
559	      {config.showContent ? (
560	        <>
561	          <ZimmProductCardMedia
562	            primaryImage={primaryImage}
563	            hoverImage={hoverImage}
564	            images={images}
565	            swapOnHover={config.showHoverImageSwap && Boolean(hoverImage)}
566	            showControls
567	            badge={resolvedBadge}
568	            onRemove={onRemove}
569	            removeLabel={removeLabel}
570	            onClick={handleMediaClick}
571	          />
572	          <ZimmProductCardContent
573	            name={name}
574	            headingLevel={headingLevel}
575	            href={href}
576	            currentPrice={currentPrice}
577	            originalPrice={originalPrice}
578	            isPriceLoading={isPriceLoading}
579	            showAttributes={config.showAttributes}
580	            colour={colour}
581	            size={size}
582	            showBag={config.showBag}
583	            isUnavailable={isUnavailable}
584	            onAddToBag={onAddToBag}
585	            showSizeChips={config.showSizeChips}
586	            sizeChipValues={sizeChipValues}
587	            selectedSizeChipValue={selectedSizeChipValue}
588	            onSizeChipSelect={onSizeChipSelect}
589	            showNotifyMe={showNotifyMe}
590	            onNotifyMe={onNotifyMe}
591	          />
592	        </>
593	      ) : (
594	        // recentlyViewed only (config.showContent === false): ZimmProductCardContent never
595	        // mounts, so its own name-link — otherwise this card's only keyboard-reachable element —
596	        // is replaced by this minimal Link wrapping Media directly. See the module docblock's own
597	        // `recentlyViewed` paragraph for the full rationale. No `onClick` on Media here: a real
598	        // `<Link>` containing the image needs no click-passthrough workaround at all — that
599	        // mechanism exists only to route around the OTHER variations' invisible stretched-overlay
600	        // `<a>`, which this branch has no need for since the link directly wraps the image
601	        // instead of sitting behind it.
602	        <MediaOnlyCardLink to={href} display="block">
603	          <VisuallyHidden>{name}</VisuallyHidden>
604	          <ZimmProductCardMedia
605	            primaryImage={primaryImage}
606	            hoverImage={hoverImage}
607	            images={images}
608	            swapOnHover={config.showHoverImageSwap && Boolean(hoverImage)}
609	            showControls
610	            badge={resolvedBadge}
611	          />
612	        </MediaOnlyCardLink>
613	      )}
614	    </chakra.div>
615	  );
616	};
617	
618	export default ZimmProductCard;

import React from 'react';
import { chakra, useMultiStyleConfig, VisuallyHidden } from '@chakra-ui/react';
import { useHistory, Link as RouteLink } from 'react-router-dom';
import { defineMessages, useIntl } from 'react-intl';
import { ZimmProductCardMedia } from '../../molecules/zimmProductCardMedia';
import type { ZimmProductCardMediaImage } from '../../molecules/zimmProductCardMedia';
import { ZimmProductCardContent } from '../../molecules/zimmProductCardContent';
import type { ZimmSizeChipValue } from '../../molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup';

// Same `chakra(RouteLink)` wrap `ZimmProductCardContent`'s own `ProductNameLink` already uses
// (see that molecule's own comment for why a router `Link` is used here rather than a plain
// anchor). Needed only for the `recentlyViewed` render branch below (SFCC-83, `!config.showContent`)
// — every other variation's one real link lives inside the composed `ZimmProductCardContent`
// instead, so this organism has no need for its own link in any other branch.
const MediaOnlyCardLink = chakra(RouteLink);

/**
 * SFCC-236 Step 6 — the organism that assembles Step 4's `ZimmProductCardMedia` and Step 5's
 * `ZimmProductCardContent` into the full product card, across the three confirmed variations.
 * Figma component set `Product-card`, node `40000223:2822` (20 variants: Size x State x Type x
 * Unavailable), file `wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm`. The variation matrix below reflects the resolved
 * `hidden`-attribute reading confirmed against the real assembled Card-content instances:
 *
 *   Home      (40000214:6141 default / 40002163:36593 hover)   — image + name only by default;
 *             bag/attributes/size-selector hidden always; a hover-CAPABLE pointer reveals price
 *             on hover. Mobile (`40000223:2821`) shows price unconditionally instead — it has no
 *             Hover variant at all, so a price hidden "by default, revealed on hover" like the
 *             original build shipped would never be revealed there at all (Fix E, found in the
 *             full-sweep follow-up audit; confirmed live as a real bug, not just a Figma reading).
 *             Arrows appear on hover-capable pointers regardless of variation (Media's own
 *             concern, driven purely by image count).
 *   PLP/PDP   (40002163:41441 default / 40002163:41459 hover)  — image + name + bag (always) +
 *             price by default, no attributes, size-selector hidden; hover hides price and
 *             reveals the size-selector in its place; arrows appear.
 *   Wishlist  (40002187:58446 default / 40002187:58458 hover)  — image + name + bag (always) +
 *             attributes (colour+size) + price by default, size-selector hidden; hover hides
 *             price and reveals the size-selector, confirmed identical to PLP's own hover reveal
 *             via node `40002187:58460` (the Wishlist hover instance carries no `hidden`
 *             attribute on "Size Selector" at all) — this is NOT what the SFCC-236 Jira AC text
 *             says (it only mentions the image switch + arrows for Wishlist hover). It shipped
 *             matching the design anyway — a judgment call made during implementation, not a
 *             conflict that was raised on the ticket or separately ratified.
 *   recentlyViewed (Desktop `40000307:12444` / Tablet `40000730:13363` / Mobile `40000538:25030`,
 *             SFCC-83) — image only. Every `VARIATION_CONFIG` flag is `false`: no name, price,
 *             bag, attributes, badge, remove button, or hover image-swap — Figma's `Tag`,
 *             `Close` and the entire `Card-content` block are `hidden="true"` on all three
 *             viewports. Arrows stay Media's own concern (driven purely by image count); this
 *             rail always supplies a single image, so they never appear in practice.
 *
 *             `ZimmProductCardContent` is unmounted entirely for this variation, but its own
 *             name-link is otherwise this card's only keyboard-reachable element — unmounting it
 *             with nothing in its place would leave zero focusable elements at all, failing
 *             SFCC-83 AC 4 ("a shopper clicks a recently viewed product tile... navigated to that
 *             product's PDP"). So a minimal `react-router-dom` `Link` (the same `chakra(RouteLink)`
 *             wrap as `ZimmProductCardContent`'s own `ProductNameLink`) is composed directly
 *             around `ZimmProductCardMedia` instead, with the product name as real,
 *             visually-hidden text via Chakra's `VisuallyHidden` — confined entirely to this
 *             file; no change to `ZimmProductCardContent` or `ZimmProductCardMedia`.
 *
 * "Recently Viewed Full History" is not a fourth variation — the AC states it behaves exactly
 * like PLP, so callers pass `variation: 'plp'` for it. (That is the separate SFCC-84 grid/page
 * surface, not the `recentlyViewed` rail variation above.)
 *
 * Unavailable=True (Fix C, SFCC-236 Step 6 visual audit) is confirmed designed for **every**
 * variation, not just `plp` — an earlier revision of this paragraph claimed the opposite, before
 * the Default+Hover Unavailable instances for `home` (40002163:39981 / :39990) and `wishlist`
 * (40002187:58452 / :58464) were actually checked. The confirmed rule, identical across all three:
 *   - The PLP/Wishlist size-selector hover-swap is suppressed entirely when unavailable — nothing
 *     to pick for an out-of-stock item, so price stays visible on hover instead of being replaced
 *     (`hoverHidesPrice`/`hoverRevealsSizeSelector` are both AND-ed with `!isUnavailable` below).
 *     Home's own hover-reveals-price behaviour is unaffected — its Unavailable Hover reference
 *     still reveals price exactly as the in-stock case does.
 *   - "Notify me" is hover-gated on hover-capable devices (hidden by default, revealed on
 *     hover/focus-visible, confirmed via every Desktop Unavailable+Hover reference) but
 *     unconditionally visible on touch (confirmed via the Mobile Unavailable references —
 *     Mobile has no Hover variant at all, so whatever they show is the only state a touch
 *     pointer ever sees, and all of them show notify-me plainly).
 * `isUnavailable` and `onNotifyMe` are threaded through uniformly to `ZimmProductCardContent`
 * (the only one of the two composed children with an `isUnavailable` concept at all —
 * `ZimmProductCardMedia` has no such prop); this organism does not itself restrict `showNotifyMe`
 * to any one variation — a caller that never passes `onNotifyMe` simply gets no notify-me button.
 *
 * Fix F (full-sweep follow-up audit, after the above was already built and approved): the
 * Desktop-only "price stays, notify-me is simply added on hover" behaviour above is NOT what
 * Mobile does. Mobile PLP/Wishlist Unavailable (`40002163:41488`, `40002187:58475`) both have
 * `Price` `hidden="true"` and only "Notify me" visible — a genuine SWAP, unlike Desktop's additive
 * treatment — where Mobile Home Unavailable (`40002163:41204`) keeps price visible alongside
 * notify-me, unchanged from Desktop. `sizeSelectorUnavailable` (already computed below for the
 * size-chip permanent-hide) drives this too, in zimmProductCard.css.ts, since it is already
 * exactly "PLP/Wishlist and unavailable" — the same condition, no new variable needed.
 *
 * The bag icon also has two Mobile-breakpoint hides, both viewport-width concerns unrelated to
 * hover capability (see zimmProductCard.css.ts's own responsive rules, keyed off the same
 * `breakpoints` token `zimmProductCardContent.css.ts` already uses for its padding steps):
 *   - `hideBagOnMobile` — PLP only, unconditional. Figma's Mobile PLP/PDP Card-content instances
 *     (`40002163:41479` available / `40002163:41488` unavailable) both have the bag icon's
 *     `Icons` frame `hidden="true"` regardless of stock status, where Desktop's own PLP instance
 *     leaves it visible.
 *   - `hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable` (Fix G, same follow-up audit) — Wishlist only, and only
 *     when unavailable. Wishlist's Mobile instance shows the bag when available
 *     (`40002187:58470`) and hides it only when unavailable (`40002187:58473`) — narrower than
 *     PLP's own unconditional rule, so it needs its own flag rather than reusing
 *     `hideBagOnMobile`. `index.tsx` combines both into one `bagHiddenOnMobile` boolean before
 *     the recipe ever sees it — the recipe only needs "hide this on mobile for this render", not
 *     which of the two reasons applies.
 *
 * KNOWN GAP: `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s `priority` prop (its LCP eager-load escape hatch) has no
 * passthrough here — every card composed via this organism lazy-loads its primary image. Not in
 * the given component contract for this step; flagged rather than added silently, since a PLP
 * page placing this organism above the fold would want it.
 *
 * Badge (feature addition, not a "Fix" like the ones above — the underlying design gap was
 * genuinely closed, not misread): `ZimmProductCardContent`'s docblock used to claim no Figma
 * design existed for SFCC-236's badge AC. It does — the "Tag" overlay, confirmed present and
 * pixel-identical on every Size/Type variant checked (nodes 40002163:41442, 40002096:12223,
 * 40002187:58447, 40002163:41478, 40004599:89266, 40004638:120485) — it was just nested one
 * level deeper (inside "Image Group", i.e. `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s domain) than the first pass
 * looked. Per Dani Rivett's scope note on the ticket, the badge shows on PLP and Wishlist (and
 * therefore Recently Viewed Full History, which already reuses the `plp` variation) and is
 * suppressed on Home — driven by `VARIATION_CONFIG.showBadge` below, the same table-driven
 * mechanism as every other variation decision in this file. Figma's own Home node still shows
 * the Tag layer un-hidden, contradicting that scope note — treating the confirmed written
 * requirement as authoritative over the file's possibly-stale layer visibility here, flagged
 * rather than silently picked.
 *
 * Badge count (confirmed after the above shipped, via a Dev Mode Connect Note on the separate
 * "Product Cards" Figma file — QQ427wHWEUjsjP7H8v48Rs, node 3448:35976 — distinct from the
 * design-system component-set file cited throughout this docblock): "only 1 product badge will
 * show up on these product cards - depending on the configured hierarchy, the highest priority
 * badge will be shown," with that priority logic owned by SFCC-225. This confirms `badge?:
 * string` (a single value, not a list) is the correct, final shape for this prop — not a
 * placeholder pending a possible future move to an array. SFCC-225's own already-merged SCAPI
 * hook writes `c_productBadges` as an array sorted by `badgePriorityOrder`, so whatever mapper
 * eventually feeds this prop (none exists yet — no page consumes this organism) just needs
 * `c_productBadges[0]?.productBadge`, not any re-sorting of its own.
 *
 * Hover image-swap on Home (same Dani-vs-AC contradiction as the Badge note above, resolved the
 * same direction): Dani's comment also says "we don't want the hover action (model photo) on
 * the homepage," but the AC update three days later frames the tile-image hover-swap as an
 * unconditional Core Component behaviour with no Home exclusion — and the code as first shipped
 * followed the AC, passing `swapOnHover` to `ZimmProductCardMedia` unconditionally with no
 * variation gate at all. Treated the comment as more authoritative than the AC text here too:
 * `VARIATION_CONFIG.showHoverImageSwap` now suppresses the swap for `home` specifically. This
 * is unrelated to, and does not affect, Home's own
 * `hoverRevealsPrice` — that is a separate mechanism (a style flag consumed by this organism's
 * own recipe), not `swapOnHover`.
 *
 * RESOLVED (SFCC-83, 2026-09-07): both quotes above, from Dani's scope note (Jira comment 13880
 * on SFCC-236), truncate at the same point. In full, her instruction is no badge and no
 * hover-image-swap on "the Homepage or on the Recently Viewed product carousel" — the Badge note
 * above and this Hover image-swap note each only implemented and discussed the Homepage half. The
 * Recently Viewed carousel half is now built: a dedicated `recentlyViewed` `VARIATION_CONFIG`
 * entry was added (both `showBadge` and `showHoverImageSwap` false, sourced from comment 13880 —
 * see the variation-matrix paragraph above for the full entry and the rest of its flags), rather
 * than a rail caller reaching for the closest existing option, `variation: 'plp'`, which would
 * have shipped exactly the opposite of what Dani asked for on that surface.
 *
 * Comment 13880 asks for the identical suppression on a second surface too — "editorial and
 * landing pages" — which has no ticket, design or AC anywhere today. That surface is deliberately
 * left unscoped, not silently folded into `recentlyViewed`: when it is scoped, it needs its own
 * `VARIATION_CONFIG` row (both flags `false`) rather than reusing `recentlyViewed` (this variation
 * is named for the one confirmed surface — reusing it for editorial/landing would misdescribe
 * what it's for) or `plp` (which would ship the badge Dani ruled out for that surface too).
 * SFCC-236's own Variation extensibility AC makes that a one-row addition when the time comes.
 *
 * Fix I (SFCC-236, found via live mobile-device testing on this branch, same round that found
 * Fix H): multi-image cards did not respond to a real touch swipe at all — the slide indicator
 * rendered correctly (so the image data/gallery logic was fine), but swiping the image never
 * paged it. Root cause and CSS fix are `zimmProductCard.css.ts`'s own Fix I (docblock point 2):
 * `ZimmProductCardMedia` was the one interactive region never lifted above the stretched-link
 * overlay, so a swipe gesture starting on the image landed on the invisible overlay `<a>` first
 * and never reached the real scroll container underneath. Lifting Media above the overlay fixes
 * the swipe, but has a side effect: a plain tap/click on the image used to "work" by landing on
 * that same overlay and navigating to the PDP — once Media sits on top, the tap no longer reaches
 * it, and Media itself had no click behaviour of its own. `handleMediaClick` below restores that
 * navigation deliberately, via `useHistory().push(href)` rather than depending on the overlay by
 * accident: this repo is pinned to react-router-dom v5.3.4 (`package.json`), which has no
 * `useNavigate` — `useHistory()` + `history.push()` is the correct v5 primitive, already
 * established in this codebase (`footer/index.tsx`, `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx`,
 * `pages/product-detail/index.tsx`) and the same one the base SFCC `product-list` page itself
 * uses. `href` needed no new prop plumbing — this organism already destructures it from its own
 * base props (above) and previously only forwarded it to `ZimmProductCardContent`. The handler
 * guards against the two arrow buttons and the remove/close button — all real `<button>`
 * descendants of `ZimmProductCardMedia` — via `(event.target as HTMLElement).closest('button')`,
 * so paging and `onRemove` keep firing on their own and never also navigate. No custom drag-vs-tap
 * detection is needed for the swipe/tap split itself: browsers natively suppress the synthetic
 * `click` event after a real drag/scroll on the same element, so a swipe pages the gallery without
 * ever reaching this handler, while a plain tap (no movement) still fires it exactly as the old
 * overlay click did.
 */

/** Re-exported under this organism's own name so a page-level caller never has to reach into a
 *  molecule's type — the shape itself is Media's own `ZimmProductCardMediaImage`, not a
 *  redeclaration (a hand-copied duplicate would silently drift from its source). */
export type ZimmProductCardImage = ZimmProductCardMediaImage;

/** `ZimmProductCardContent`'s own already-derived heading-level type (`'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3'`,
 *  itself derived from `ZimmProductName`'s `as` prop) — read via `ComponentProps` off the
 *  component this organism actually forwards it to, rather than a hand-typed duplicate union. */
type ZimmProductCardHeadingLevel = React.ComponentProps<typeof ZimmProductCardContent>['headingLevel'];

/**
 * Exported alongside `ZimmProductCardProps` (not just kept module-private) so a test/fixture can
 * build a properly *narrowed* per-variation props object — e.g.
 * `ZimmProductCardBaseProps & ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation` — instead of a value typed as the
 * full union. This matters for real, not just for convenience: TypeScript's excess-property
 * check on a *union* target is weak (a property valid on any one member is not flagged as excess
 * on a fresh literal discriminated toward a different member), so proving "the wishlist-only
 * fields don't exist on Home" needs an assignment to Home's own narrow shape specifically, not to
 * the union alias — see index.test.tsx's `@ts-expect-error` cases and its overloaded
 * `buildCardProps` helper.
 */
export type ZimmProductCardBaseProps = {
  /** Stable per-card identifier. Not used for any layout/behavioural decision — exposed as a
   *  `data-product-id` attribute on the root element as a DOM hook for QA automation/analytics,
   *  the same kind of caller-facing marker `data-testid` already serves in this build's other
   *  components, without overloading that attribute's own testing-only convention. */
  id: string;
  /** PDP destination, pre-site-prefixed by the caller — forwarded straight to
   *  `ZimmProductCardContent`'s own `href` (see that component's own JSDoc on trust level). */
  href: string;
  name: string;
  headingLevel: ZimmProductCardHeadingLevel;
  primaryImage: ZimmProductCardImage;
  hoverImage?: ZimmProductCardImage;
  images?: ZimmProductCardImage[];
  currentPrice?: string;
  originalPrice?: string;
  isPriceLoading?: boolean;
  isUnavailable?: boolean;
  /** Only meaningful when `isUnavailable` is true. See the module docblock for why this is not
   *  restricted to the `plp` variation at the type level. */
  onNotifyMe?: () => void;
  /**
   * Merchandiser-configured badge label (e.g. "Runway", "Exclusive"). Always a single value —
   * confirmed via a Figma Dev Mode Connect Note that only the single highest-priority badge is
   * ever shown, never a list (see the module docblock's "Badge count" note). Not restricted to
   * any variation at the type level, same reasoning as `onNotifyMe` above — whether it actually
   * renders is `VARIATION_CONFIG.showBadge`'s job (PLP/Wishlist show it, Home suppresses it; see
   * the module docblock's "Badge" note).
   */
  badge?: string;
};

export type ZimmProductCardPlpVariation = {
  variation: 'plp';
  onAddToBag?: () => void;
  sizeChipValues?: ZimmSizeChipValue[];
  selectedSizeChipValue?: string;
  onSizeChipSelect?: (value: string) => void;
};

export type ZimmProductCardHomeVariation = {
  variation: 'home';
  // No additions — Home never shows the bag, attributes, or size chips (see VARIATION_CONFIG).
};

export type ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation = {
  variation: 'wishlist';
  /** Required, not optional — the Wishlist AC always shows the attributes line. */
  colour: string;
  size: string;
  /** Required — a wishlist card with no way to remove itself is a spec violation. */
  onRemove: () => void;
  /** Bag is always visible for Wishlist per the confirmed matrix above. */
  onAddToBag?: () => void;
  /** Same trio `ZimmProductCardPlpVariation` declares, and for the same reason: confirmed via the
   *  real Figma Wishlist Hover instance (node 40002187:58458) during the SFCC-236 Step 6 visual
   *  audit that Wishlist's hover reveal is a genuine, populated size-selector swap identical to
   *  PLP's — not a PLP-only affordance. `index.tsx`'s render body already forwarded these
   *  unconditionally to `ZimmProductCardContent` for every variation (via the
   *  `ZimmProductCardVariationFields` cast below); this type previously just didn't expose them
   *  to a Wishlist caller, which is what let the Wishlist story ship without ever populating them. */
  sizeChipValues?: ZimmSizeChipValue[];
  selectedSizeChipValue?: string;
  onSizeChipSelect?: (value: string) => void;
};

/**
 * SFCC-83 — the Recently Viewed rail tile. Image only: every `VARIATION_CONFIG` flag is `false`,
 * so this variation adds no fields of its own — see `VARIATION_CONFIG`'s own `recentlyViewed`
 * row and the module docblock's matching paragraph for the confirmed Figma reading.
 */
export type ZimmProductCardRecentlyViewedVariation = {
  variation: 'recentlyViewed';
  // No additions — the rail tile is image-only; see VARIATION_CONFIG and the module docblock.
};

export type ZimmProductCardProps = ZimmProductCardBaseProps &
  (
    | ZimmProductCardPlpVariation
    | ZimmProductCardHomeVariation
    | ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation
    | ZimmProductCardRecentlyViewedVariation
  );

type ZimmProductCardVariation =
  | ZimmProductCardPlpVariation['variation']
  | ZimmProductCardHomeVariation['variation']
  | ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation['variation']
  | ZimmProductCardRecentlyViewedVariation['variation'];

/**
 * Widened, not narrowed: every variation-specific field is optional here regardless of which
 * branch is actually active, purely so the component body below can destructure once with no
 * `if`/`switch` on `props.variation` — the extensibility AC requires every layout/visibility
 * decision to come from `VARIATION_CONFIG`, keyed by the discriminant, never a branching
 * statement. The exported `ZimmProductCardProps` discriminated union above is what actually
 * enforces correct usage at every call site (proven by the `@ts-expect-error` cases in
 * index.test.tsx) — this cast only relaxes internal access inside this file; it changes nothing
 * about what a caller may legally pass in.
 */
type ZimmProductCardVariationFields = Partial<
  Omit<ZimmProductCardPlpVariation, 'variation'> &
    Omit<ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation, 'variation'> &
    Omit<ZimmProductCardHomeVariation, 'variation'>
>;

type ZimmProductCardVariationConfig = {
  showBag: boolean;
  showAttributes: boolean;
  showSizeChips: boolean;
  /** PLP/Wishlist: price is visible by default and hides on hover. */
  hoverHidesPrice: boolean;
  /** Home only: price is hidden by default and reveals on hover. */
  hoverRevealsPrice: boolean;
  /** PLP/Wishlist: the size-chip picker is hidden by default and reveals on hover. */
  hoverRevealsSizeSelector: boolean;
  showRemove: boolean;
  /** PLP only (found during the SFCC-236 Step 6 visual audit): Figma's Mobile Card-content
   *  instance has the bag icon's `Icons` frame `hidden="true"`, unlike Desktop and unlike
   *  Wishlist's own Mobile instance (bag stays visible there on every breakpoint). A viewport-
   *  width concern, not a hover one — see zimmProductCard.css.ts's own responsive rule. */
  hideBagOnMobile: boolean;
  /** Wishlist only (found during the follow-up full-sweep visual audit against every variant x
   *  state node): unlike PLP's unconditional `hideBagOnMobile`, Wishlist's Mobile Card-content
   *  instance shows the bag icon when available (`40002187:58470`) and hides it
   *  (`Icons` frame `hidden="true"`) only when unavailable (`40002187:58473`) — narrower than
   *  `hideBagOnMobile`, and combined with it (not replacing it) in the `bagHiddenOnMobile`
   *  derivation below, since the two are mutually exclusive per variation today but there is no
   *  reason to assume that stays true forever. */
  hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: boolean;
  /** Shown on PLP/Wishlist, suppressed on Home — see the module docblock's "Badge" note. */
  showBadge: boolean;
  /**
   * Allows `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s primary/hover image crossfade for this variation. Suppressed
   * on Home per Dani Rivett's scope note, overriding the AC's unconditional framing — see the
   * module docblock's "Hover image-swap on Home" note. `false` here means a supplied
   * `hoverImage` is simply never swapped to, regardless of pointer capability.
   */
  showHoverImageSwap: boolean;
  /**
   * Whether `ZimmProductCardContent` mounts at all. Every other flag in this type only ever
   * hides a SUB-PART of Content (the bag, the attributes row, the size chips...) while Content
   * itself always renders regardless — this is the one flag that suppresses the whole component.
   * `false` only for `recentlyViewed` (SFCC-83): the rail tile is image-only, per Figma's
   * `Card-content` `hidden="true"` on all three viewports. See `index.tsx`'s own render body for
   * how a keyboard-reachable link is preserved even with Content fully unmounted.
   */
  showContent: boolean;
};

/**
 * The extensibility AC's actual mechanism: every layout/visibility decision this organism makes
 * reads from this table, keyed by `variation` — adding a future variation means adding a union
 * member above and one row here, touching no JSX. `index.tsx`'s render body contains no
 * `switch`/`if` on `props.variation` anywhere (verify with
 * `grep -n 'variation ===\|switch (variation)' index.tsx` — zero hits).
 */
const VARIATION_CONFIG: Record<ZimmProductCardVariation, ZimmProductCardVariationConfig> = {
  home: {
    showBag: false,
    showAttributes: false,
    showSizeChips: false,
    hoverHidesPrice: false,
    hoverRevealsPrice: true,
    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: false,
    showRemove: false,
    hideBagOnMobile: false,
    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
    showBadge: false,
    showHoverImageSwap: false,
    showContent: true,
  },
  plp: {
    showBag: true,
    showAttributes: false,
    showSizeChips: true,
    hoverHidesPrice: true,
    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: true,
    showRemove: false,
    hideBagOnMobile: true,
    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
    showBadge: true,
    showHoverImageSwap: true,
    showContent: true,
  },
  wishlist: {
    showBag: true,
    showAttributes: true,
    showSizeChips: true,
    hoverHidesPrice: true,
    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: true,
    showRemove: true,
    hideBagOnMobile: false,
    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: true,
    showBadge: true,
    showHoverImageSwap: true,
    showContent: true,
  },
  recentlyViewed: {
    showBag: false,
    showAttributes: false,
    showSizeChips: false,
    hoverHidesPrice: false,
    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: false,
    showRemove: false,
    // Moot — there is no bag on any viewport for this variation (Card-content is hidden
    // wholesale below), so this flag never actually applies. Figma nodes: Desktop 40000307:12444,
    // Tablet 40000730:13363, Mobile 40000538:25030 — Card-content `hidden="true"` on all three.
    hideBagOnMobile: false,
    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
    showBadge: false,
    showHoverImageSwap: false,
    showContent: false,
  },
};

const messages = defineMessages({
  // Interpolated with the product name, matching ZimmProductPrice's WAS/NOW pattern — Media's
  // own `removeLabel` prop is a plain string, so the interpolation happens here, at the one call
  // site that actually knows the product name.
  removeFromWishlist: {
    id: 'product_card.remove.from_wishlist',
    defaultMessage: 'Remove {name} from wishlist',
  },
});

const ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_RECIPE = 'ZimmProductCard';

/**
 * Organism — the full product card, composing `ZimmProductCardMedia` and `ZimmProductCardContent`
 * across the `home` / `plp` / `wishlist` variations. See the module docblock above for the
 * confirmed Figma variation matrix and this component's own recipe (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`) for
 * the stretched-link and hover-reveal mechanics that live entirely in CSS, not in this render
 * body — both children are always rendered in full, with every one of their own sub-parts; CSS
 * alone decides what is visible for a given variation and pointer capability.
 *
 * @param props see `ZimmProductCardProps` — a discriminated union on `variation`.
 */
export const ZimmProductCard = (props: ZimmProductCardProps) => {
  const {
    id,
    href,
    name,
    headingLevel,
    primaryImage,
    hoverImage,
    images,
    currentPrice,
    originalPrice,
    isPriceLoading,
    isUnavailable,
    onNotifyMe,
    badge,
    variation,
  } = props;

  const { onAddToBag, sizeChipValues, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect, colour, size, onRemove } =
    props as ZimmProductCardVariationFields;

  const intl = useIntl();
  const history = useHistory();
  const config = VARIATION_CONFIG[variation];

  // Both conditions required — an organism that sets isUnavailable without a real callback
  // should not show a dead notify-me button. Mirrors ZimmProductCardContent's own
  // showNotifyMeButton co-requirement.
  const showNotifyMe = Boolean(isUnavailable) && Boolean(onNotifyMe);

  // Fix C (SFCC-236 Step 6 visual audit): confirmed against the real Figma Default+Hover
  // instances for every variation × Unavailable=True (including the Mobile/no-hover variants,
  // which show the only state a touch pointer ever sees) that `isUnavailable` suppresses the
  // size-selector hover-swap entirely — there is nothing to pick for an out-of-stock item, so
  // price stays visible on hover instead of being replaced. Home's own hover-reveals-price
  // behaviour is untouched by this — Home's Unavailable Hover reference (node 40002163:39990)
  // still reveals price on hover exactly as the in-stock case does; only the PLP/Wishlist
  // hide-and-swap needs suppressing.
  //
  // Suppressing `hoverRevealsSizeSelector` alone is not enough to reproduce that reference: it
  // only stops the organism adding its OWN hide/reveal pair, which leaves the size-chip wrapper
  // at Content's own natural (visible) default — briefly shipped that way mid-fix and caught by
  // re-checking the real Storybook render against Figma, which confirms size chips stay hidden
  // in BOTH states when unavailable, not just "not swapped in on hover". `sizeSelectorUnavailable`
  // carries that permanent hide separately, unconditional (not gated by hover-capability at all —
  // this isn't a pointer-type concern, unlike everything else in this recipe).
  //
  // Follow-up (full-sweep visual audit against every variant x state node, not just the sampled
  // set the first pass checked): `sizeSelectorUnavailable` ALSO drives a mobile-only price hide
  // in the recipe now (Fix F) — confirmed via `get_metadata` that Mobile PLP/Wishlist Unavailable
  // hide price and show notify-me in its place (`40002163:41488`, `40002187:58475`), the OPPOSITE
  // of Desktop's additive treatment (price stays, notify-me is simply added on hover). Nothing
  // extra is computed here for it — the recipe reads the same `sizeSelectorUnavailable` boolean
  // for both the size-chip permanent-hide and this new price rule, since both only ever apply to
  // the same PLP/Wishlist-and-unavailable case.
  const hoverHidesPrice = config.hoverHidesPrice && !isUnavailable;
  const hoverRevealsSizeSelector = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && !isUnavailable;
  const sizeSelectorUnavailable = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && Boolean(isUnavailable);

  // Fix G (same follow-up audit): Wishlist-only. `hideBagOnMobile` alone only covers PLP's own
  // unconditional mobile hide; Wishlist's bag stays visible on mobile UNLESS unavailable
  // (`40002187:58470` vs `40002187:58473`). Combined into one boolean here rather than exposing
  // both conditions to the recipe — it only needs to know "hide this on mobile for this render",
  // not why.
  const bagHiddenOnMobile = config.hideBagOnMobile || (config.hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable && Boolean(isUnavailable));

  const removeLabel = config.showRemove ? intl.formatMessage(messages.removeFromWishlist, { name }) : undefined;
  const resolvedBadge = config.showBadge ? badge : undefined;

  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_RECIPE, {
    hoverHidesPrice,
    hoverRevealsPrice: config.hoverRevealsPrice,
    hoverRevealsSizeSelector,
    sizeSelectorUnavailable,
    // Same Fix C audit: notify-me is hover-gated on hover-capable devices (hidden by default,
    // revealed on hover/focus-visible — every Desktop Unavailable+Hover reference shows it
    // appearing only there) but unconditionally visible on touch (every Mobile Unavailable
    // reference — the only state a touch pointer ever sees, per the "Mobile has no Hover variant"
    // finding — shows it plainly, with no hover to reveal it). This flag is deliberately keyed off
    // `showNotifyMe` itself, not `variation`: the confirmed behaviour is identical across all
    // three variations, and the recipe's selector simply matches nothing when notify-me isn't
    // mounted at all.
    hoverRevealsNotifyMe: showNotifyMe,
    hideBagOnMobile: bagHiddenOnMobile,
  });

  // Fix I — see the module docblock's own "Fix I" paragraph for the full narrative. Guards the
  // two arrow buttons and the remove/close button (all real <button> descendants of
  // ZimmProductCardMedia) so paging/onRemove keep firing on their own and never also navigate.
  // Fix L (CodeRabbit finding on PR #85, verified correct before fixing): a real <a> lets the
  // browser handle Cmd/Ctrl-click (new tab), Shift-click (new window), and non-primary-button
  // clicks natively — this handler only ever replaces the in-page navigation an UNMODIFIED,
  // primary-button click used to reach via the stretched-link overlay (see Fix I). Bailing out on
  // any of those instead of forcing an in-tab `history.push` regardless of what the shopper
  // actually asked for; a no-op here is a real gap (it doesn't open a new tab the way a real link
  // would) but is strictly better than silently overriding an explicit "open elsewhere" signal.
  const handleMediaClick = (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void => {
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    if (target.closest('button')) return;
    if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey || event.button !== 0) return;
    history.push(href);
  };

  return (
    <chakra.div __css={styles.root} data-testid="product-card" data-product-id={id}>
      {config.showContent ? (
        <>
          <ZimmProductCardMedia
            primaryImage={primaryImage}
            hoverImage={hoverImage}
            images={images}
            swapOnHover={config.showHoverImageSwap && Boolean(hoverImage)}
            showControls
            badge={resolvedBadge}
            onRemove={onRemove}
            removeLabel={removeLabel}
            onClick={handleMediaClick}
          />
          <ZimmProductCardContent
            name={name}
            headingLevel={headingLevel}
            href={href}
            currentPrice={currentPrice}
            originalPrice={originalPrice}
            isPriceLoading={isPriceLoading}
            showAttributes={config.showAttributes}
            colour={colour}
            size={size}
            showBag={config.showBag}
            isUnavailable={isUnavailable}
            onAddToBag={onAddToBag}
            showSizeChips={config.showSizeChips}
            sizeChipValues={sizeChipValues}
            selectedSizeChipValue={selectedSizeChipValue}
            onSizeChipSelect={onSizeChipSelect}
            showNotifyMe={showNotifyMe}
            onNotifyMe={onNotifyMe}
          />
        </>
      ) : (
        // recentlyViewed only (config.showContent === false): ZimmProductCardContent never
        // mounts, so its own name-link — otherwise this card's only keyboard-reachable element —
        // is replaced by this minimal Link wrapping Media directly. See the module docblock's own
        // `recentlyViewed` paragraph for the full rationale. No `onClick` on Media here: a real
        // `<Link>` containing the image needs no click-passthrough workaround at all — that
        // mechanism exists only to route around the OTHER variations' invisible stretched-overlay
        // `<a>`, which this branch has no need for since the link directly wraps the image
        // instead of sitting behind it.
        <MediaOnlyCardLink to={href} display="block">
          <VisuallyHidden>{name}</VisuallyHidden>
          <ZimmProductCardMedia
            primaryImage={primaryImage}
            hoverImage={hoverImage}
            images={images}
            swapOnHover={config.showHoverImageSwap && Boolean(hoverImage)}
            showControls
            badge={resolvedBadge}
          />
        </MediaOnlyCardLink>
      )}
    </chakra.div>
  );
};

export default ZimmProductCard;

content.text:
## Summary Branch confirmed: `feature/SFCC-83-84_recently-viewed` (not `develop`/`main`). Implemented plan step **A2 — Add the `recentlyViewed` variation to `ZimmProductCard`** from `~/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-83+84/plan.md`. Only the three named files were touched: - `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.tsx` - `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.test.tsx` - `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx` `zimmProductCard.css.ts` was **not** touched — everything was achievable with a `config.showContent` ternary in the render body plus plain Chakra props (`display="block"`). `git status --porcelain` confirms exactly these three files changed, nothing staged. ## What changed, file by file **`index.tsx`** (+199/-54 per `git diff --stat`): - New import `VisuallyHidden` from `@chakra-ui/react`, `Link as RouteLink` from `react-router-dom`, and a new top-of-file `const MediaOnlyCardLink = chakra(RouteLink)` (mirrors `ZimmProductCardContent`'s own `ProductNameLink` idiom, per the plan's instruction). - Module docblock: added a `recentlyViewed` paragraph to the variation matrix (citing Desktop `40000307:12444` / Tablet `40000730:13363` / Mobile `40000538:25030`); rewrote the "Whoever builds SFCC-83 needs to…" KNOWN GAP paragraph into a "RESOLVED" record citing Jira comment 13880, plus the editorial/landing-pages-remain-unscoped note (must not reuse `recentlyViewed` or `plp`). - Added `ZimmProductCardRecentlyViewedVariation` type (`{variation: 'recentlyViewed'}`, no additions) to the `ZimmProductCardProps` and `ZimmProductCardVariation` unions. - Added `showContent: boolean` to `ZimmProductCardVariationConfig` with JSDoc explaining it's the one flag that suppresses the whole `ZimmProductCardContent` child (every other flag only hides a sub-part). - Added `showContent: true` to `home`/`plp`/`wishlist` rows; added the `recentlyViewed` row (every flag `false`), with the exact `hideBagOnMobile` Figma-node comment specified in the task. - Render body: `config.showContent ? <>... : {name}` — the `true` branch is byte-identical to the prior unconditional render; the `false` branch omits `onClick`, `onRemove`, `removeLabel` from `ZimmProductCardMedia`. **`index.test.tsx`** (+83/-… ): added `ZimmProductCardRecentlyViewedVariation` to type imports; added a `buildCardProps('recentlyViewed')` overload; added a `@ts-expect-error` compile-time test (narrow intersection, `onRemove` rejected); added `'recentlyViewed'` to the existing "exactly one real anchor" `test.each`; added a new describe block with badge-suppression, hover-swap-suppression, Content-absence, and real-link tests. **`index.stories.tsx`**: corrected the now-false "`variation` has no fourth value" docblock claim; added the `RecentlyViewed` named export (single `primaryImage` only, no badge/hover/size-chip props). ## A discovery I'm flagging, not silently resolving While proving the "product name as its accessible name" pass criterion, the initial test (`getByRole('link', {name: 'Natura Dress'})`, exact match) failed: ``` Name "Natura Dress Zimmermann dress, front": ... ``` The composed ``'s alt text is concatenated onto the anchor's computed accessible name (standard name-from-content behaviour for a link containing an image) — it isn't purely the `VisuallyHidden` text. This directly conflicts with the task's own two instructions: "primaryImage/hoverImage/images pass through as normal" vs. "the product name as its accessible name." Suppressing the composed image's `alt` (e.g. `alt=""`, a recognized WCAG technique for a redundant image inside an already-labelled link) would fix this cleanly, but it would mean deliberately not "passing through as normal" and touching a value on the shared `ZimmProductCardMediaImage` contract informally documented elsewhere as "always non-empty." message.content:
The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
Independent Tester pass on your A2 work found one real bug and two smaller gaps. All three are closing confirmed gaps against already-established design intent, not new decisions — proceed directly.

**1. Must-fix — confirmed, reproduced bug: the `images` gallery prop isn't sanitized in the `recentlyViewed` branch.** `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s own gallery mode activates purely off `images.length > 1`, completely independent of any of this variation's config flags. The Tester proved, with a real render: if `recentlyViewed` ever receives `images` with >1 entries, you get (a) carousel arrow `<button>`s nested inside the wrapping `<Link>` — invalid nested-interactive HTML, (b) a real double-navigation bug — clicking "Next image" bubbles to the ancestor `<Link>` and also fires PDP navigation (confirmed via a mounted `<Route>` marker), and (c) every gallery image's own un-blanked `alt` text concatenating onto the link's accessible name — the exact bug you already fixed for `primaryImage`/`hoverImage`, just multiplied across every slide.

This is currently dormant (nothing shipped calls it this way — A3's mapper is designed to always supply exactly one image), but it's a live gap in this component's exported, extensibility-oriented contract (`images` lives on `ZimmProductCardBaseProps`, unrestricted by variation).

Fix: in the `!config.showContent` branch only, don't forward `images` to `ZimmProductCardMedia` at all — this variation's entire design intent is single-image, so just omit the prop there (Media already defaults to single-image mode with no `images` supplied). Leave the `true` branch (home/plp/wishlist) completely untouched. Add a short comment at the omission citing why (gallery mode must never activate for this variation — nested-interactive HTML + a real double-navigation bug otherwise, found during A2's own Tester pass).

**2. Should-fix — no explicit focus ring on `MediaOnlyCardLink`.** Every other interactive control in this component family (`zimmColourSwatch`, `zimmNavItem`, `zimmSizeChip`, `zimmButton`, Media's own `close`/`arrowButton`, Content's `nameLink`/`bagButton`/`notifyMeButton`) carries an explicit `var(--zimm-focus-ring)`-family rule. This new link relies on the browser's native default outline instead — WCAG 2.4.7 is technically satisfied (nothing strips it), but it's a real, visible inconsistency with the established convention, and your own doc-comment says it copies `ProductNameLink`'s pattern when it only copied the wrap, not the focus styling.

Fix confined to `index.tsx` only — do NOT touch `zimmProductCard.css.ts` (still off-limits per your original brief). Add an inline `sx`/`__css` prop directly on `MediaOnlyCardLink` with a `_focusVisible` rule using the same tokens every other control uses: `outline: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring)'`, `outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)'`. This is a plain Chakra `sx` escape hatch referencing already-registered tokens, not a new recipe part — consistent with `overrideStyling.md`'s styling hierarchy.

**3. Should-fix — test coverage gap against the plan's own stated pass criterion.** The plan says the new variation's narrow type must reject `colour`/`size`/`onRemove` — only `onRemove` got a `@ts-expect-error` test. The Tester independently confirmed `colour`/`size` ARE genuinely rejected by the compiler too, so this is a missing-test gap, not a behavior bug. Add the two missing `@ts-expect-error` cases (same pattern as the existing `onRemove` one, assigned to the narrow intersection type).

After all three: re-run `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run test`, `npm run lint` (baseline: 26/5/21, zero new), and specifically re-verify the multi-image case is now actually safe — render a `recentlyViewed` card with a real multi-image `images` array and confirm no nested buttons, no double-navigation, and the link's accessible name stays exactly the product name regardless of how many images are passed.

Report back with the diff for all three and real command output for each gate.

Address this before completing your current task.

content.text:
All confirmed. Here's the report.

## Diff for all three fixes

**1. Must-fix — `images` no longer forwarded in the `recentlyViewed` branch** (`index.tsx`, inside `!config.showContent`'s `ZimmProductCardMedia` call): the `images={images}` line was deleted outright (not replaced with anything), with a comment explaining why — gallery mode activates purely off `images.length > 1` in `ZimmProductCardMedia`, independent of any `VARIATION_CONFIG` flag, so the only way to guarantee it never activates for this variation is to never pass the prop at all. The `true` branch's own `images={images}` (home/plp/wishlist) is untouched.

**2. Should-fix — explicit focus ring on `MediaOnlyCardLink`** (`index.tsx`): added `sx={{ _focusVisible: { outline: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring)', outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)' } }}` directly on the link, citing `zimmTokens.ts:68-69` (verified those are the exact registered token lines) and the existing `_focusVisible` pattern already used identically in `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts:28-29`, `zimmSizeChip.css.ts:88-95`, `zimmNavItem.css.ts:47-49`, `zimmButton.css.ts:33-35`. `zimmProductCard.css.ts` untouched, as instructed.

**3. Should-fix — missing `@ts-expect-error` cases** (`index.test.tsx`): added `recentlyViewed variation does not accept colour (type-only)` and `...does not accept size (type-only)`, each its own test with its own narrow-intersection object literal, mirroring the existing `onRemove` case exactly.

**Verification test added** (`index.test.tsx`): `a multi-image gallery passed as images never activates gallery mode: no nested buttons, no double-navigation, accessible name stays exactly the product name` — renders a `recentlyViewed` card with the file's existing 3-image `GALLERY` fixture and asserts zero buttons render at all, exactly one link with accessible name exactly `'Natura Dress'`, and that clicking it never calls `mockHistoryPush` (the mechanism this file already uses to prove no click-passthrough handler fired).

## Gate confirmation (all re-run after all three fixes)

- **`npx tsc --noEmit`** — clean, no output.
- **`npm run test`** — `Test Files 55 passed (55)`, `Tests 902 passed (902)` (up from 899; +3 new tests). `zimmProductCard/index.test.tsx` alone: `76 tests` passed. `ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts` (29 tests) and `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts` (6 tests) re-checked individually — both pass, confirming the hard styling gate is unaffected (no recipe file was touched).
- **`npm run lint`** — `26 problems (5 errors, 21 warnings)` — identical to the baseline, zero new problems, none in any of the three files.
